# Mineradio Wallpaper Pulse

The particle wallpaper code used by `web/src/StarfieldCanvas.tsx` is copied from
the `Preset 5: WALLPAPER PULSE` implementation in Mineradio:

- Source: <https://github.com/XxHuberrr/Mineradio/blob/main/public/index.html>
- Project: <https://github.com/XxHuberrr/Mineradio>
- Author: Hu Bo / XxHuberrr
- Copyright: Copyright (c) 2025-2026 Hu Bo
- License: GNU General Public License v3.0
- Source revision inspected: `6b130103f759e5dcd1e133700071c8216b8fa5a6`

Redio-specific changes are limited to the React canvas lifecycle and the
removal of unrelated Mineradio player presets and controls. The Wallpaper Pulse
particle formulas, shader constants, dot texture, default particle density,
material mode, and camera values are retained from the source implementation.

The upstream GPL-3.0 license is available at:
<https://github.com/XxHuberrr/Mineradio/blob/main/LICENSE>
